summary: Clone an intrinsic Request, teeing its body and rejecting unusable body state.

semantics.body: body stream is cloned/teed; clone and original are independently consumable branches
semantics.unusable: throws TypeError if body is disturbed or locked

tests.name: clone body can be consumed separately
used body cannot be cloned
tests.input: const r=new Request("https://e.test/",{method:"POST",body:"x"}); await r.text(); try { r.clone(); } catch(e) { console.log(e.name); }
